The '''Droidnostics Center''' was an area of [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]]' [[Tomorrowland Starport]] used for [[droid]] repair and maintenance, almost entirely staffed by droids themselves. The term "[[Droidnostics]]" refers to a droid diagnostics system.<ref name="CGTST" />

Around the time of the [[Battle of Death Star III]], [[G2-4T]] served as the foreman supervising other droids. [[G2-9T/Legends|G2-9T]] was working on [[R5-D2]] in the center's Sector 2 at the time, but was more interested in chatting with guests passing by than doing his work and was scolded for low productivity.<ref name="ST">[[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']]</ref> The cluttered area was cleaned by janitor droid [[max-W 100]], and was also home to [[Unidentified MSE droid series|Mouse Droids]] and [[Bird Droid]]s.<ref name="CGTST" />

==Behind the scenes==
The queue of [[The Walt Disney Company|Disney's]] original [[Star Tours (real-world)|Star Tours]] attractions passed through this area. A playset based on Sector 2 to be used with action figures from the [[Star Wars: Star Tours (toy line)|''Star Tours'' toy line]] was once planned by Disney, but was never released.<ref name="Taking Off">{{InsiderCite|104|Star Tours: Taking Off on a Star Tour|''Star Tours'': Taking Off on a Star Tour}}</ref>
